thread:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync — QBR asks us to produce an MDF scenario for the 'HW + SI bundle' go-to-market. Need numbers and a proposed comms cadence by EOW.

aj (product-marketing): Can you clarify scope? Is this for the APAC pilot only or global launch?

maria (partnerships): Global, but phased. Phase 1 = APAC pilot (2 regions), Phase 2 = NA EU. Budget ask should show what we need to support launch ROI in each phase.

kevin (finance): FYI we have a ~250k MDF pool available for partner initiatives this quarter, but we should model optimistic/baseline/conservative. I can run sensitivity.

sophia (ops): Also need to include HW co-marketing credits and SI integration professional services credits. Ops will want lead times for collateral and enablement (4–6 weeks).

leo (sia): From SI side: we can commit to 3 integrations with reference customers in pilot. Will need dev sprints estimates (2 sprints each) and a small co-fund for integration QA.

maria (partnerships): Great. Drafting scenarios — rough here, feel free to sanity-check: 

```
Scenario A (Optimistic): MDF needed = $200k, HW credits = $120k, SI credits = $80k, Expected incremental ARR (12mo) = $3.6M
Scenario B (Baseline):  MDF needed = $120k, HW credits = $70k,  SI credits = $50k, Expected incremental ARR = $1.8M
Scenario C (Conservative): MDF needed = $60k,  HW credits = $35k,  SI credits = $25k, Expected incremental ARR = $900k
```

aj (product-marketing): These look reasonable. For QBR slide we should also include: expected deal velocity lift (%), attachable margin %, and partner GTM tasks. I'll mock a slide.

kevin (finance): Running the math — baseline has payback ~4.5 months if ARR conversion is front-loaded; optimistic is <3 months. I can produce an ROI table with churn assumptions.

sophia (ops): Action: ops to confirm collateral lead time and localization. Need to know if we want translated assets for APAC pilot.

maria (partnerships): Action items (TL;DR):
- maria: finalize scenario numbers + one-pager for QBR (due Thu)
- kevin: ROI table and sensitivity (due Thu)
- aj: draft launch comms and slide deck (due Fri)
- sophia: ops lead-time confirmation + localization estimate (due Fri)
- leo: SI sprint estimates + reference customer readiness (due Thu)

leo (sia): Quick note: SI will ask for a $15k integration QA stipend per reference integration in baseline. Putting that in the model changes baseline MDF -> $135k.

maria (partnerships): Good call — include that as an optional line item in the QBR one-pager.

announce-bot: Reminder: QBR materials due by 2026-05-12 17:00 PT.

aj (product-marketing): For comms cadence proposal: 
- Week 0: partner announcement teaser (social + partner channels)
- Week 2: joint blog + product deep-dive webinar (recorded)
- Week 4: customer case study announce (pilot)
- Ongoing: joint demand gen plays (co-marketing credits applied per conversion)

kevin (finance): One more scenario request — show net MDF request after hardware vendor credits (i.e., how much Redwood is actually co-funding). Can ops/partners confirm vendor credit estimates?

sophia (ops): Reached out to HW partner today; rough estimate: vendor credits might cover ~40% of HW credits in optimistic, ~25% baseline, ~15% conservative. I'll update when confirmed.

maria (partnerships): Perfect. If everyone agrees, I'll fold these into the QBR doc and circulate a single-sheet. If anyone needs a different modeling column (e.g., include channel reseller uplift) say now.

aj (product-marketing): Add a column for 'SI enablement cost' vs 'SI rebate' so we can show net SI burden.

kevin (finance): OK — I'll add those columns.

maria (partnerships): Thanks team — will ping when draft is ready. :thumbsup:

leo (sia): Quick ping — can we set a 20m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to unblock estimates?

maria (partnerships): Scheduling now. Calendar invite sent.

aj (product-marketing): :rocket:

kevin (finance): Added to calendar.

sophia (ops): Noted.

maria (partnerships): Closing thread — will attach the one-pager in channel when ready.
